study.title: ResLMFFNet: a real-time semantic segmentation network for precision agriculture
study.short_title: ResLMFFNet real-time semantic seg (tree/crop/rust), RTX5000 fps

segmentation.domain: real-time binary semantic segmentation of precision-agriculture targets in remote-sensing imagery: tree (RIT-18 aerial/octocopter), crop (DSTL satellite), wheat yellow-rust disease (DJI Matrice 100 UAV)
models_tested: ResLMFFNet (proposed; residual SEM-B blocks + dropout MAD decoder)
segmentation.best_model: ResLMFFNet (M=3, N=8 SEM-Bs, decoder dropout p=0.5): RIT-18 tree IoU 0.884 / F1 0.913 (RGB); DSTL crop IoU 0.896 / F1 0.913; Wheat Yellow-Rust IoU 0.681 / F1 0.781; same 1.34 M params / 12.73 GFLOPs and near-identical FPS as LMFFNet

dataset.name: RIT-18 tree set (Hamlin State Beach Park, aerial octocopter) as primary; also DSTL crop (Kaggle satellite) and Wheat Yellow-Rust (DJI Matrice 100 UAV)
dataset.note: RIT-18: single orthomosaic 9393x5642 px, 18 labelled classes, tree pixels as binary target, GSD 0.047 m, ENVI-delineated ground truth. DSTL: 25 satellite images, 1000x1000 m, 1.24 m resolution. Wheat Yellow-Rust: 1336x2991 px, 0.013 m GSD, MATLAB ImageLabeler GT, 2x2 m rust-inoculum zones. All sets patched to 224x224 (DSTL 5985, RIT-18 1778, Wheat 1299 patches), split 72% train / 20% test / 8% val with 5-fold cross-validation; RGB and NDVI inputs.

segmentation.backbone: SEM-B blocks (split-extract-merge bottleneck) with residual connections, PMCA attention, FFM-A/FFM-B fusion, MAD attention decoder with dropout 0.5

mIoU.quote: Table 2: Tree semantic segmentation test results in terms of Jaccard Index (IoU) and F1 score ... ResLMFFNet (proposed) 0.884 +/- 0.252 (RGB)
mIoU.ambiguity: Primary value = RIT-18 tree task (UAV octocopter, RGB), mean +/- std over 5-fold CV. Other tasks (RGB/NDVI): DSTL crop 0.896/0.888, Wheat Yellow-Rust 0.681/0.620, tree DSTL 0.503/0.427. Jaccard Index = IoU (Eq. 11).

F1.quote: Table 2: Tree semantic segmentation test results ... ResLMFFNet (proposed) 0.913 +/- 0.214 (RGB)
F1.ambiguity: Primary value = RIT-18 tree task (RGB). Other tasks (RGB/NDVI): DSTL crop 0.913/0.904, Wheat Yellow-Rust 0.781/0.740, tree DSTL 0.638/0.550.

Dice.ambiguity: Dice not used; evaluation metrics are Jaccard Index (IoU) and F1 (Eq. 11-13).

weed_F1.ambiguity: No weed task; target objects are trees, crops and wheat yellow-rust (no crop/weed discrimination).

crop_F1.quote: Table 3: Crop semantic segmentation test results ... ResLMFFNet (proposed) 0.913 +/- 0.247 (RGB)
crop_F1.ambiguity: Crop-class F1 from the DSTL satellite crop task (1.24 m resolution, RGB), mean +/- std; not UAV imagery. NDVI crop F1 0.904.

edge.framework: PyTorch, Adam optimizer, binary cross-entropy with logits, Xavier init, batch 8, 70 epochs; NVIDIA Quadro RTX 5000 GPU (training and inference timing)

fps.quote: Table 1: Performance comparison of real-time semantic segmentation architectures ... ResLMFFNet (proposed) ... RIT-18 image set FPS 98.91
fps.ambiguity: Real-time FPS on DESKTOP NVIDIA Quadro RTX 5000 (input 3x224x224), not an edge device. Per-set: RIT-18 98.91, DSTL 108.55, Wheat Yellow-Rust 97.86. LMFFNet marginally faster (99.38/109.09/99.84). GPU inference memory 18.01 MB (torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated).

latency_ms.ambiguity: Only FPS reported, no per-image latency. Edge deployment (Jetson TX series on quadcopters) explicitly listed as future work.

params_M.ambiguity: Structural model size (identical to LMFFNet, 1.34 M); unaffected by residual connections. Ablations: M=3/N=12 -> 1.82 M, M=5/N=8 -> 1.40 M.

gflops.ambiguity: Computational complexity at 3x224x224 input, identical to LMFFNet. Reported GFLOPs (inference), not training FLOPs.

issues: Multi-task/multi-dataset study (tree RIT-18 UAV, crop DSTL satellite, wheat yellow-rust M100 UAV); single-value metrics record the RIT-18 tree task (RGB) with per-dataset values in ambiguity.
Real-time FPS measured on desktop NVIDIA Quadro RTX 5000; edge deployment (Jetson TX on quadcopters) is proposed future work only, so edge.reported=false.
crop_F1 comes from the DSTL satellite crop task (not UAV); NDVI variants reported alongside RGB.
All values are mean +/- std over 5-fold cross-validation on 224x224 patches; binary segmentation tasks.
No pixel accuracy, Dice, power or latency reported.
